segments.sn23.21:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn23.21:1.5: “Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, samudayadhammo, vedanā samudayadhammo, saññā samudayadhammo, saṅkhārā samudayadhammo, viññāṇaṃ samudayadhammo.
segments.sn23.21:1.6: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
